d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

The Manager, Sales Enablement & Process Management is responsible for driving consistency, effectiveness, and operational excellence across key seller processes within Visa's Commercial & Money Movement Solutions (CMS) organization in CEMEA.
This role owns the frameworks, governance, enablement, and continuous improvement of critical sales processes that support seller productivity and commercial execution.

Working across Product, Commercialization, Sales Excellence, Finance, Marketing, and Regional Leadership teams, the role ensures sellers have access to the right content, processes, tools, training, and governance structures required to execute effectively.

The role acts as the regional process owner and orchestrator for key seller programs including Knowledge Management, AANR governance, Sales Plays, Lead Management, Training Management, and SIP governance support, ensuring alignment between global direction and regional execution.
q: BA/BS in Business, Economics, or Finance. Preferred candidate with MBA/ relevant masters degree.
6-8 years experience in sales/ sales support, marketing, finance or equivalent fields
Experience in process optimization, sales and lead management within B2B organizations, ideally with multi-product solutions
Experience in and/or significant exposure to the financial services/payments industry required
Must be detail oriented to ensure accuracy and quality of output
Proficiency in tools like Claude, Co-pilot, Perplexity, Power BI and Tableau
Global or multi-national business experience strongly preferred
Ability to work effectively with a diverse team and produce time sensitive deliverables
Structured thinker with strong analytical and decision-making skills
Excellent collaborator, able to influence without authority and rally resources to achieve business goals
Adaptable and quick learner, comfortable with complexity and ambiguity
Innovative, able to think outside the box and drive projects to completion
Attention to detail, supporting recommendations with data and facts
Strong personal presence and communication skills, both verbal and written
Self-confident and hands-on, with the ability to operate in a fast paced and constantly changing work environment
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
r: Own the CEMEA CMS knowledge management framework and govern Compass and SharePoint as trusted, accessible sources of seller content.
Establish clear standards for content ownership, quality, lifecycle, structure, and review in partnership with Product, Commercialization, and Business Unit teams.
Continuously improve content relevance, discoverability, platform adoption, and the overall seller knowledge experience.
Lead the regional AANR validation process, partnering with Finance, Sales Excellence, Product, and Sales to ensure submissions meet established recognition and evidence requirements.
Validate and reconcile submissions for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness, while identifying governance and data quality risks.
Provide leadership with clear visibility into validation progress, key risks, remediation actions, and opportunities to strengthen the operating framework.
Own the CEMEA CMS Sales Plays operating model and coordinate the full lifecycle from prioritization and readiness through launch, seller activation, measurement, and post launch review.
Orchestrate Global and Regional stakeholders across Product, Commercialization, Marketing, Sales Excellence, and Sales to ensure clear ownership and consistent execution.
Evaluate adoption, lead and pipeline contribution, and commercial outcomes to inform leadership decisions and continuously improve future Sales Plays.
Own the regional lead management framework, connecting campaign activity, seller follow up, opportunity attribution, and pipeline reporting.
Partner across Marketing, Product, Commercialization, Business Units, and Sales to improve lead quality, conversion, data discipline, and seller accountability.
Monitor lead progression and performance, addressing process gaps and providing transparent reporting on execution and commercial impact.

Own the CEMEA CMS training framework and calendar, orchestrating Global, Regional, and Business Unit enablement activities into a coordinated learning experience aligned with seller needs and commercial priorities.

Establish a structured training needs assessment process, using seller feedback, business priorities, performance insights, and stakeholder input to identify capability gaps and prioritize learning interventions.
Embed critical seller processes, tools, and governance requirements into onboarding and ongoing learning journeys to improve role readiness and execution consistency.
Measure participation, adoption, seller feedback, and effectiveness to continuously improve training quality and business impact.
Serve as the designated backup for SIP governance, supporting continuity of validation, reporting, and governance activities when required.
Partner with Finance, Sales Excellence, and business stakeholders to maintain data accuracy, process compliance, and reliable performance reporting.
Support process documentation and improvement initiatives that strengthen governance consistency and operational resilience.

Design and continuously improve regional operating models, workflow standards, ownership structures, and controls for assigned seller processes, translating Global frameworks into practical CEMEA execution.
Establish structured feedback loops with sellers, Business Units, and Regional stakeholders to identify process friction, assess effectiveness, and inform future improvements.

d: We are looking for an observant and data-driven social media analyst to judge and evaluate the success of social media and web presence of any brand/campaign/Initiative by looking at posts' metrics. The social media analyst will be responsible for providing feedback to clients and social media / CX directors to let them know how a campaign/brand/Initiative has been received and how it can be adjusted through professional reports.

Social media analysts are responsible for analyzing the performance of social media platforms and their related content. They look at everything from individual posts to entire accounts, tracking metrics such as likes, shares, retweets, etc.

Therefore the social media analysts create professional reports that summarize their findings or present them in a more easily understandable format. These reports can be requested internally or externally to inform clients about how well their social media efforts are performing.
q: Experience in any social media role, content creator, or a similar role.
Excellent knowledge of any social media tools and trends.
r: Making notes of posts that perform poorly and finding evidence poor perfomance.
Providing constructive criticism to content creators to help them make improvements.
Observing follower engagement and building a report on their behaviors.
Researching new social media trends and tools.
Keeping up to date with current events and pop culture to better understand user behavior.
Monitoring social media channels for mentions of company or brand names to identify potential customer service issues or opportunities for increased brand awareness.
Analyzing user data to identify behavioral patterns in order to improve engagement with content.
Creating reports with analytical findings and recommendations for Internal (sales, marketing, etc.) or external (customers, prospects) requests.
